name: Tumgazeteler Döviz ve Altın Kurları
author: tumgazeteler

sections.description:
Tumgazeteler Döviz ve Altın Kurları (“Tumgazeteler Exchange Rates and Gold Prices”) is the easiest way to add up-to-date currency and gold prices in Turkish Lira (TRY) to your WordPress site. It needs no configuration: add it to a sidebar as a widget, or to any post or page with a shortcode.

It is a good fit for news sites, newspapers, finance and economy blogs, jewellers, exchange offices, and any Turkish website that wants to show its visitors current market prices.

Rate data is provided by tumgazeteler.net, a website that brings together all Turkish newspapers and news sites on a single page.

Features

  • Current rates in Turkish Lira: US dollar, euro, British pound, Swiss franc, Saudi riyal, gram gold, quarter gold (çeyrek altın), half gold, full gold, Republic gold coin, Ata gold coin, 22 carat gold bracelet, silver, and ONS gold (shown in USD).
  • Buying price, selling price and daily change: Rising prices are shown with a green arrow, falling prices with a red arrow.
  • Choose your rates: Select only the rates you need in the widget settings.
  • Light and dark themes: Pick the look that matches your site.
  • Responsive: In narrow sidebars the table automatically hides the buying price column.
  • Fast: Data is cached on your server for 10 minutes. No JavaScript runs in the visitor’s browser and no external files are loaded.
  • Reliable: If the data source cannot be reached, the last known rates are shown.
  • Lightweight: One PHP file and one small CSS file.

Shortcode

Default table:

[doviz_kurlari]

Selected rates with the dark theme:

[doviz_kurlari kalemler="USD,EUR,gram-altin,ceyrek-altin" tema="koyu"]

Available codes: USD, EUR, GBP, CHF, SAR, gram-altin, ceyrek-altin, yarim-altin, tam-altin, cumhuriyet-altini, ata-altin, 22-ayar-bilezik, ons, gumus

To hide the source link:

[doviz_kurlari kaynak="0"]

External services

This plugin gets exchange rate and gold price data from the tumgazeteler.net service, which is operated by the plugin author. When the table is displayed, your server sends a request to https://tumgazeteler.net/kur.php at most once every 10 minutes. No visitor data is sent; only your site address is included in the user-agent header.

Service provider: https://tumgazeteler.net/
Contact and terms: https://tumgazeteler.net/iletisim.html
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Tumgazeteler Döviz ve Altın Kurları” and install it, or upload the zip file under Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Appearance > Widgets and add the “Döviz ve Altın Kurları” widget to a sidebar, or add the [doviz_kurlari] shortcode to a post or page.
sections.faq:
How often are the rates updated?

Rates are refreshed at most every 10 minutes. The time of the last update is shown below the table.

Which currency are the prices in?

All prices are in Turkish Lira (TRY), except ONS gold, which is shown in US dollars.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. Rates are cached on your server, so no external request is made on every page view, and no JavaScript is loaded for visitors.

Can I remove the source link below the table?

Yes. Uncheck “Kaynak bağlantısını göster” in the widget settings, or use kaynak="0" in the shortcode.

Why do the rates show “-“?

If your server could not reach the data source the first time, the rates are shown as “-” temporarily. This fixes itself within a few minutes.
